basic.name: Singularity Spike
basic.description: Flings a Singularity Spike that sticks to the first enemy hit. Deals 240~~0.04~~ damage after 1 second and Slows the enemy by 40% for 3 seconds.

basic.name: Blink
basic.description:
Teleport to the target location.

Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

basic.name: Seeker in the Dark
basic.description: Teleport to the active Singularity Spike target.

heroic.name: Might Of The Nerazim
heroic.description:
Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.

Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

heroic.name: Void Prison
heroic.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

heroic.name: Singularity Spike
heroic.description: Flings a Singularity Spike that sticks to the first enemy hit. Deals 120~~0.04~~ damage after 1 second and slows the enemy by 40% for 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Blink
heroic.description:
Teleport to the target location. 

Using this Ability does not break cloak.

trait.name: Permanent Cloak
trait.description: Gain Stealth when out of combat for 3 seconds. Taking damage, attacking, using Abilities, or Channeling ends Stealth. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

activable.name: Vorpal Blade
activable.description: Activate to teleport to Zeratul's last non-structure Basic Attack target within 3 seconds. The target is revealed during these 3 seconds.

activable.name: Spell Shield - Disabled
activable.description:
Spell Shield is disabled and will not trigger.

Click this button to enable Spell Shield.

activable.name: Darkness Descends
activable.description:
Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.

level1.name: Greater Cleave
level1.description: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.

level1.name: Shadow Hunter
level1.description:
Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3, up to 45.

Reward: Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.

level1.name: Move Unseen
level1.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

level4.name: Rending Cleave
level4.description: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

level4.name: Psionic Strength
level4.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

level4.name: Darkness Descends
level4.description:
Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.

level7.name: Wormhole
level7.description: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from within 4 seconds.

level7.name: Seeker in the Dark
level7.description: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.

level7.name: Warp Skirmisher
level7.description: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting to an enemy with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% more damage.

level10.name: Might Of The Nerazim
level10.description:
Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.

Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

level10.name: Void Prison
level10.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

level13.name: Shroud of Adun
level13.description: Zeratul gains a Shield equal to 20% of his Maximum Health over 3 seconds while under Permanent Cloak.

level13.name: Mending Strikes
level13.description: Basic Attacks heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

level13.name: Spell Shield
level13.description:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level16.name: Master Warp-Blade
level16.description: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% more damage.

level16.name: Void Slash
level16.description: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

level16.name: Sentenced to Death
level16.description: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

level20.name: Twilight Falls
level20.description: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.

level20.name: Unwavering Pressure
level20.description: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.

level20.name: Shadow Stride
level20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260~~0.04~~ damage for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Shadow Mending
level20.description: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.
